subject: Re: Follow-up + next tests — Observability & hyperscaler comparison
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@acme.ai>, Elena Morales <em@acme.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Post-call recap + proposed next tests (observability focus)

Thanks Jonathan and Elena — great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared expectations.

Recap (high level):
- Acme evaluation criteria: predictable 99th pct latency, per-route cost visibility, trace-level request debugging, multi-region failover, and compliance for audit logs.
- You want a head-to-head vs hyperscaler endpoints (Bedrock / Vertex / Azure AI) focusing on production observability and operational tooling, not just raw generation quality.
- Timeline: you mentioned a 2-3 week technical POC to validate perf and telemetry before procurement.

Proposed POC scope (what we suggest next):
1) Performance/latency test: 20 qps steady-state + burst to 100 qps; measure P50/P95/P99, cold vs warmed KV cache; compare Redwood-optimized model vs competitor endpoint provided by you.
2) Streaming & partial-response behavior: verify client streaming latencies and reconnect behavior under degraded network.
3) Observability & tracing: instrument 1000 sample requests across routes and show:
   - per-request tracing (trace id => token-level timing)
   - per-route token-level cost breakdown
   - error and rate-limit dashboards + alerting hooks (PagerDuty / Opsgenie)
   - export to Datadog & S3 (audit logs).
4) Integration checks: test structured output + function/tool calling and how we represent those in traces.

What we need from you to start:
- Short-lived test keys (or a small request proxy) so we can call your comparator endpoints consistently.
- Sample prompt set (10-20 canonical prompts) and expected success criteria per prompt.
- A primary POC contact (name + availability windows).

Attachments: I attached our latest observability matrix (redwood-observability-matrix-v2.pdf) and a starter mutual action plan (2026-03-15-acme-quick-ma-plan.xlsx). I also added a short PoC instructions markdown with the specific endpoints and sample curl commands.

Next steps / scheduling: can we kick off the POC this Thursday (Mar 18) or next Monday (Mar 22)? If you prefer, we can run an initial 30-min runbook sync to align telemetry and credentials.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions (West) 
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 16 Mar 2026 at 08:10:00 -0700, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Rishi — can you add a short checklist in the matrix for the infra touches (trace header name, sampling options, required metadata) and a quick example curl that sets the trace id and sampling flags?

Yep — adding that now. Quick summary for the POC/instrumentation so everyone is aligned:

Instrumentation checklist (to be pasted into the matrix):
- Trace header: X-Redwood-Trace-Id (we accept W3C traceparent too).
- Sampling: we support explicit sample=true/false via X-Redwood-Sample (defaults to probabilistic at 0.5 for hosted tests). For deterministic POC capture, use X-Redwood-Sample: 1.
- Required metadata: route_name, model_variant, request_id, tenant_id (send as headers or JSON fields).
- Export: raw traces streamed to S3 (JSONL) + optional Datadog APM export (api key) - retention 90 days by default, can extend for enterprise.
- Token timing: we emit per-token timestamps and aggregate per-request token cost.

Example curl (POC):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REdwood_TEST_KEY>" 
  -H "X-Redwood-Trace-Id: 0001-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00" 
  -H "X-Redwood-Sample: 1" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"route_name":"acme_chat_v1","model_variant":"r-instruct-4b-q4","prompt":"{{prompt}}"}'

I'll attach the updated observability matrix to the Drive folder and flag the specific infra items.

Also: David — if we see consistent P99 > 350ms due to load patterns, recommend we propose a Dedicated-capacity trial for the customer as an optional next phase (I can include cost delta estimates).

—
Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
